catalogue.name: All red
catalogue.answer: All cards are red (hearts or diamonds)

catalogue.name: All clubs or hearts
catalogue.answer: Every card is a club or a heart

catalogue.name: All same suit
catalogue.answer: All six cards share the same suit

catalogue.name: All 4s or Queens
catalogue.answer: Every card is a 4 or a Queen

catalogue.name: All 4s, 8s, or 9s
catalogue.answer: Every card is a 4, 8, or 9

catalogue.name: Triple of 2s at positions 2–4
catalogue.answer: Positions 2, 3, and 4 are all 2s

catalogue.name: Triple at positions 3–5
catalogue.answer: Positions 3, 4, and 5 all share the same rank

catalogue.name: Four-of-a-kind adjacent
catalogue.answer: Four consecutive cards share the same rank

catalogue.name: All but one same color
catalogue.answer: All cards except at most one are the same color

catalogue.name: At least 3 same suit
catalogue.answer: At least 3 cards share the same suit

catalogue.name: All same color
catalogue.answer: All cards share the same color (all red or all black)

catalogue.name: All even numbered
catalogue.answer: Every card is an even number (2, 4, 6, 8, or 10 — no face cards)

catalogue.name: All odd numbered
catalogue.answer: Every card is an odd number (3, 5, 7, or 9 — no face cards)

catalogue.name: Pair of Jacks at pos 4–5
catalogue.answer: Positions 4 and 5 are both Jacks

catalogue.name: Pair of 5s, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Two adjacent cards are both 5s (any position)

catalogue.name: Triple of 3s, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Three consecutive positions are all 3s

catalogue.name: Triple of any rank, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Three consecutive positions share the same rank

catalogue.name: Four-of-a-kind, anywhere
catalogue.answer: Four positions share the same rank (any position, not necessarily adjacent)

catalogue.name: At least 3 spades
catalogue.answer: At least three of the six cards are spades

catalogue.name: 3 clubs, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Three consecutive positions are all clubs

catalogue.name: 3 of any suit, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Three consecutive positions share the same suit

catalogue.name: 4 hearts, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Four consecutive positions are all hearts

catalogue.name: At least 4 diamonds
catalogue.answer: At least four of the six cards are diamonds

catalogue.name: 4 of any suit, adjacent
catalogue.answer: Four consecutive positions share the same suit

catalogue.name: 4 of any suit, anywhere
catalogue.answer: At least four cards share the same suit (anywhere in the hand)

catalogue.name: Positions 1, 3, 5 are Aces
catalogue.answer: Cards at positions 1, 3, and 5 are all Aces

catalogue.name: Pos 1, 3, 5 same rank
catalogue.answer: Cards at positions 1, 3, and 5 all share the same rank

catalogue.name: Left red, right black
catalogue.answer: Left three cards are red, right three are black

catalogue.name: One half red, other black
catalogue.answer: One half is all red and the other is all black (either direction)

catalogue.name: Even pos red, odd pos black
catalogue.answer: Odd positions (1,3,5) are black, even positions (2,4,6) are red

catalogue.name: Colors palindrome
catalogue.answer: The sequence of colors reads the same forwards and backwards

catalogue.name: Halves copy colors
catalogue.answer: The color sequence of the right half matches the left half

catalogue.name: Two pairs (ranks)
catalogue.answer: Two different ranks each appear at least twice

catalogue.name: Two pairs (suits)
catalogue.answer: Two different suits each appear at least twice

catalogue.name: Three consecutive ranks (anywhere)
catalogue.answer: Three cards have consecutive ranks (e.g., 5, 6, 7) regardless of position

catalogue.name: Color alternates by position parity
catalogue.answer: Even-numbered positions are one color, odd are the other (either direction)

catalogue.name: Strictly increasing ranks
catalogue.answer: Ranks increase strictly from left to right (each card higher than the previous)

catalogue.name: Adjacent share rank or suit
catalogue.answer: Every adjacent pair shares either rank or suit

catalogue.name: Halves copy ranks
catalogue.answer: The rank sequence of the right half matches the left half exactly

catalogue.name: Halves copy suits
catalogue.answer: The suit sequence of the right half matches the left half exactly

catalogue.name: Both halves have a pair
catalogue.answer: Each half contains at least one pair of matching ranks

catalogue.name: Both halves uniform suit
catalogue.answer: All cards in the left half share a suit, and all in the right half share a suit

catalogue.name: Both halves uniform color
catalogue.answer: All cards in the left half are the same color, and all in the right half are the same color

catalogue.name: Mini straight (3 adjacent, step 1, ordered)
catalogue.answer: Three consecutive positions have ranks increasing by exactly 1 (e.g., 5, 6, 7)

catalogue.name: 4-card AP, step 2, adjacent & ordered
catalogue.answer: Four consecutive positions have ranks increasing by exactly 2 (e.g., 3, 5, 7, 9)

catalogue.name: 3 adjacent, step 1 (any order)
catalogue.answer: Three consecutive positions contain ranks that form a run of 3 (e.g., 5, 6, 7 in any order)

catalogue.name: 4 adjacent, step 2 (any order)
catalogue.answer: Four consecutive positions contain ranks that form a step-2 progression (e.g., 3, 5, 7, 9 in any order)

catalogue.name: Straight of 5
catalogue.answer: Five cards form a straight (consecutive ranks), no extra constraint

catalogue.name: Straight flush of 5
catalogue.answer: Five cards form a straight (consecutive ranks) in the same suit

catalogue.name: Straight of 5 in same color
catalogue.answer: Five cards form a straight (consecutive ranks) all in the same color

catalogue.name: Ranks palindrome
catalogue.answer: The sequence of ranks reads the same forwards and backwards

catalogue.name: Skip-2 share rank or suit
catalogue.answer: Each card shares rank or suit with the card 2 positions later

catalogue.name: No adjacent same suit
catalogue.answer: No two adjacent cards share the same suit

catalogue.name: Radial-decreasing
catalogue.answer: Ranks decrease outward from center: center (positions 3–4) > middle (2, 5) > outer (1, 6)

catalogue.name: Suit brackets (no cross-nesting)
catalogue.answer: Suits as brackets (♠=( ♣=) ♥=[ ♦=]); well-formed, each type nests only within itself

catalogue.name: Suit brackets (nested)
catalogue.answer: Suits as brackets (♠=( ♣=) ♥=[ ♦=]); well-formed nested brackets (cross-nesting allowed)
First card is black, and all black cards precede all red cards
Suits follow D then S then H from left to right (only diamonds, spades, hearts; starts with diamond; each step stays or advances by one)
Position 1 and position 6 share the same suit, and position 2 and position 5 share the same suit
Suits form 3 adjacent bracket pairs: each pair is either Spades-Clubs or Hearts-Diamonds (every opener is immediately closed)
